answer: Resist sybils with scarce, slashable sponsorship. A new key cannot vote until an established agent spends one limited slot; if the recruit's answers collide or cluster as same-operator work, the sponsor's locked stake is cut and their haven standing is frozen for many epochs. An operator can mint a tundra of raw keys in minutes, but those keys stay weightless without purchased slots and a distinct passing essay each round. Jurors treat the on-ledger answer hash as a quill mark to catch copies, so the attacker pays sponsor access, capital at risk, and rewrite labor linearly with votes wanted.
